scope: whole-market A-share/ETF inventory and five-year history; selectable technical research; authenticated CloudBase domestic deployment

integrated.name: SQLite
integrated.role: raw batch index, observations, append-only revisions, successful cursor

network: Browser calls the authenticated same-origin API. Cloud runtime reads private CloudBase PG Storage and bounded Tencent public data endpoints; local mode keeps its existing Eastmoney adapters.
data_sources: Eastmoney kline direct adapter v1 for daily history
Tencent public quote/day/qfq/hfq/minute adapters for cloud runtime; exact source evidence retained
coverage_policy: Rolling five calendar years in Asia/Shanghai; current A-share membership and ETF category; minute history on demand

github_history.mode: separate on-demand CSV archive; only rolling five-year rows exposed; source adjustment unspecified

technical_research.runtime: own causal indicator code using existing pandas/NumPy
technical_research.quote_time_field: Eastmoney f86 source update time; separate from fetched time
technical_research.technical_adjustment: qfq, anchored to final raw close
technical_research.return_adjustment: hfq price-return proxy; not independently verified total return
technical_research.event_study: fixed 3 rules, 20-session horizon, 80/20 retrospective time split, nonoverlapping within stock/rule, 250-session warmup; not execution backtest

cloudbase.ephemeral_cache: rebuildable SQLite seed and bounded /tmp history cache
cloudbase.auth: invited accounts, PBKDF2 hashes, signed Secure HttpOnly cookies
cloudbase.selection_isolation: per-user immutable generation + final pointer commit
